gbm_population_evidence.quote: Suspected recurrent glioblastoma that is clearly measurable based on the modified Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology (RANO) criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: When FUS is combined with 5-ALA, this combinatorial approach is called sonodynamic therapy (SDT), and this investigational therapy is being tested for its ability to cause damage to GBM cells.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Sonodynamic Therapy in Patients With Recurrent GBM

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Histologic tumor devitalization: Evaluating cell fate and cell death via histologic samples after GBM resection
Researchers seek to determine the safety and feasibility of this therapy as well as measure its effectiveness to elicit tumor-cell death.

role_evidence.quote: 5-ALA (20mg/kg orally) given \~6 hours prior to LIFU.
The combination of 5-ALA (Gleolan) and LIFU is collectively known as sonodynamic therapy (SDT).

agents.drug_class_hint: 5-aminolevulinic acid (Gleolan), porphyrin precursor sonosensitiser activated by low-intensity focused ultrasound
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: sonodynamic therapy: 5-ALA combined with focused ultrasound to cause damage to GBM cells / elicit tumor-cell death

coder_notes: 5-ALA sonodynamic therapy with NaviFUS LIFU before resection of recurrent GBM; 5-ALA is the candidate with device_dependent true (the LIFU device is not an agent). Target engagement coded yes on the basis of histologic tumour devitalization / cell death in resected tissue after SDT (window design, no explicit pre/post pairing); an adjudicator may consider this a response endpoint. Gadolinium mentioned only in exclusion criteria and not listed. cns5_terminology historical because conditions use 'Glioblastoma Multiforme'.
